title: Not Just Optimized
description: An all in one, mostly client side modpack good for every type of device and any type of game play with modern vanilla optimization, and highly customizable settings and features. Works on low end devices, and minimal configuration required for beginners.
body: An all in one modpack made for any type of device in any type of scenario. Highly beginner friendly, and very convenient for even the best minecraft experts. Includes modern vanilla+ client side optimization, pvp quality of life mods like a built in Armour HUD and totem counter, as well as simple tweaks that make the game feel smoother and easier to play, like togglable night vision and low fire. Made completely for the latest version of minecraft.
